scripts.db:migrate: bash -c 'cd backend || exit 1; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m alembic upgrade head; else exec python3 -m alembic upgrade head; fi'
scripts.dev:api: bash -c 'cd backend || exit 1; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000; else exec python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000; fi'
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run dev:api"
